items.title: Does teaching actually cost more time, once you count what comes after?
items.description: This is a simplified teaching model, not a promise that one lesson makes someone perfect forever. Priya's fix took 5 minutes; asking questions took 25. Drag the sliders to compare today's shortcut with the future help Sam may still need if the same kind of problem returns.

params.name: numFutureOccurrences
params.label: Times this problem type returns later

params.name: recurrencePercent
params.label: Chance Sam gets stuck again if never taught

items.compute: const directFixMinutes = 5; const teachingExtraMinutes = 20; const expectedRecurrences = params.numFutureOccurrences * (params.recurrencePercent / 100); const mentorTimeIfAlwaysDirect = directFixMinutes + directFixMinutes * expectedRecurrences; const postTeachingRecurrenceRate = 0.2; const mentorTimeIfTaughtOnce = directFixMinutes + teachingExtraMinutes + directFixMinutes * expectedRecurrences * postTeachingRecurrenceRate; return { mentorTimeIfAlwaysDirect, mentorTimeIfTaughtOnce };

outputs.label: Total mentor time — always fix it directly
